wire.errors.bedrock.access_denied: AWS denied this request in {region}: the identity lacks an Amazon Bedrock IAM permission.
wire.errors.bedrock.aws_cli_missing: The AWS CLI (aws) is not installed on this computer, so the AWS sign-in cannot run. Install it or run the sign-in yourself.
wire.errors.bedrock.check_list_denied: These AWS credentials work in {region} but cannot list Amazon Bedrock models; the built-in model list will be used.
wire.errors.bedrock.check_unverified: Could not reach Amazon Bedrock in {region} to check this connection. It was saved without being verified.
wire.errors.bedrock.connection_missing: That Amazon Bedrock connection no longer exists.
wire.errors.bedrock.context_failed: Could not read your AWS configuration: {detail}
wire.errors.bedrock.credential_resolutio: Could not load AWS credentials for Amazon Bedrock: {detail}
wire.errors.bedrock.credential_timeout: Loading AWS credentials for Amazon Bedrock took longer than {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
wire.errors.bedrock.credentials_rejected: Amazon Bedrock rejected these AWS credentials in {region}.
wire.errors.bedrock.iam_denied: Your AWS identity is not allowed to call {action} on {resource}. Ask your AWS admin to grant it in IAM; other models may still work.
wire.errors.bedrock.input_invalid: This Amazon Bedrock connection request is not valid: {field} is missing or malformed.
wire.errors.bedrock.invalid_api_key: Amazon Bedrock rejected the API key in {region}: it is malformed or invalid. Check that the whole key was copied, or create a new one.
wire.errors.bedrock.invalid_connection: This Amazon Bedrock connection is not valid ({detail}). Connect Bedrock again.
wire.errors.bedrock.model_access: This AWS account has no access to {model} in {region}. Enable access to the model in the Amazon Bedrock console, or pick another model.
wire.errors.bedrock.model_unavailable: {model} is not available in {region}. Try its global. or regional inference profile (for example us.), or another Region.
wire.errors.bedrock.no_credentials: No AWS credentials for Amazon Bedrock. Set {bearer_env}, or on an AWS worker set {auth_env}, or connect Bedrock with a stored connection.
wire.errors.bedrock.profile_no_credentia: AWS profile {profile} has no usable credentials for Amazon Bedrock.
wire.errors.bedrock.profile_not_found: AWS profile {profile} was not found in your AWS config.
wire.errors.bedrock.region_invalid: {region} is not a valid AWS Region id.
wire.errors.bedrock.secret_missing: The saved Amazon Bedrock credential is missing from the encrypted store. Run {command} to connect again.
wire.errors.bedrock.session_expired: The AWS sign-in session for profile {profile} has expired. Run {command}, then try again.
wire.errors.bedrock.sso_busy: An AWS sign-in for profile {profile} is already running.
wire.errors.bedrock.sso_headless: No browser can reach you from this server, so the AWS sign-in cannot run here. Run {command} yourself.
wire.errors.bedrock.sso_not_applicable: Profile {profile} does not use IAM Identity Center or aws login.
wire.errors.bedrock.use_aws_panel: Amazon Bedrock connects through its AWS panel: choose a method, a Region and a profile or key there.
